title: No CSP test asserts eu.posthog.com stays absent
detail: csp_test.gleam pins presence of intended sources via contains+exactly-once and well-formedness be_false checks, but never asserts eu.posthog.com is absent. Adding it to any directive would pass every test.
recommended_fix: Add `p |> string.contains("eu.posthog.com") |> should.be_false` inside the enforcement-additions loop to lock the documented absence the no-op relies on.
